items.title: Bob Coquille Interview, 1978-11-15
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] I've never met any of them but Jack Lane used to talk about the Lawrence who was the father

ctx.x: His father played with Jack Lane. He's a Vecca also that plays piano. He used to work at the Times for Keown. He's related to Larry Vecca.
I've never met any of them but Jack Lane used to talk about the Lawrence who was the father
I guess. Yeah. Larry Vecca. Well Larry used to have a big nine, ten, twelve piece band and he operated for many years. And he, my friend, he saw the ad in the paper he came up and grabbed the guitar.
